v55_checks.note: v5.5: OWNER MESSAGING + GOATCOUNTER ACTION EVENTS + JOB 5 AND JOB 6 DATA MERGES. (1) Messaging (Yelp gap audit row 11): schema v12 (rankly-plan/yourtownpros-supabase-schema-v12.sql, applied separately by the back office, never by this build) adds threads + messages: a thread belongs to one business and one signed-in customer and records the review or match request that opened it; messages are private between the two parties (no moderation status, no public rendering anywhere), RLS admits only the thread's customer and the business's approved owner (the v6 claims test), inserts pin the caller to their own side and role, bodies are 1 to 2000 characters, and the v4 throttle pattern caps threads at 10 per customer per day and messages at 30 per sender per day.
